- `src/server/rpc/runs.ts` and `src/contracts.ts`: `list_helper_threads` returns each helper’s phase and queued task IDs. It includes idle writers with open attempts, excludes helpers whose attempts ended and workspace-provisioner threads, paginates in pages of 100, and logs list errors. `src/ui/helper-threads.tsx` and `src/ui/composer-agent-badge.tsx`: queued tasks appear as one «в очереди N» chip; polling interval is unchanged.
- `components/ui/icon-extended.tsx` and `components/ui/icon-registry.ts` register the builtin brand icon names `Figma`, `Notion`, `Slack`, `Telegram`, `Youtube`, `GoogleDoc` and `GoogleDrive`, alongside the existing names, which are unchanged. The test in `src/spreadsheet/link-chip.test.ts` checks against `EXTENDED_ICON_NAMES`.
- `src/studio/studio-panel.tsx` and `src/studio/header-action.tsx`: the Office Studio icon (Palette) in the thread header and the panel + menu entry both open the studio launcher in a right-panel tab. The panel action id is `STUDIO_PANEL = "studio"`. The launcher lists Prototype, Paint and Slides. Slides is disabled with a soon badge. Picking Prototype or Paint switches within the same tab, and Back to tools returns to the list. EN and RU texts live in `src/shared/i18n.ts`.
